original_post_text:
𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐒𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐜𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭?

People keep asking why some Texas poker rooms get raided while others stay open. The laws are the same, however some poker rooms use a membership model and charge time. Others take a pot rake in plain sight with no consequence. It's called Selective Enforcement and no, I didn't make this up. It's a legal term.

Selective enforcement happens when authorities, law enforcement, regulators, or licensing boards, inconsistently apply the rules. Same activity. Different treatment. That's not justice, that's discretion being used as a weapon.

In Texas, poker rooms operate in the same legal gray area. Same statute. Same structure. But not the same outcomes. When one room gets raided and another doesn't, one of the questions worth asking isn't "was the law broken?" It's "why was this room chosen?"

Shomari Williams | The Sham Report
#TexasPoker #SelectiveEnforcement #TheShamReport #pokerlife

expanded_body:
Originally posted April 20, 2026.

What is selective enforcement?

People keep asking why some Texas poker rooms get raided while others stay open. The laws are the same; however, some poker rooms use a membership model and charge time, while others take a pot rake in plain sight with no consequence. It's called selective enforcement — and no, I didn't make this up. It's a legal term.

Selective enforcement happens when authorities — law enforcement, regulators, or licensing boards — inconsistently apply the rules. Same activity. Different treatment. That's not justice; that's discretion being used as a weapon.

In Texas, poker rooms operate in the same legal gray area. Same statute. Same structure. But not the same outcomes. When one room gets raided and another doesn't, one of the questions worth asking isn't "was the law broken?" It's "why was this room chosen?"

— Sham
